I went to school for a few years so I can read what is written on the seed and fertilizer bags, but I still do what worked for my neighbors last season. Since this 0.64 hectare plot is rented, I will not put my manure here — I keep that for my own land. I will buy one bag of DAP and half a bag of urea from the cooperative if the subsidized stock arrives on time, which means I will apply about 35 kilograms of nitrogen per hectare. My cousin got a better harvest with improved seed last year, so I will use that too, and my family will handle most of the work with about five days of hired labor when the weeds come up.
